digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text cutover with state-based echo suppression
propositions: Cloud and DC send paths must route through rich-text codecs (ADF and rendered wiki respectively) with state-based echo suppression comparing current Jira value against last-synced baseline to prevent infinite loops in lossy round-trips

Two distinct comparison operations must be maintained: emit compares normalized outbound against decoded inbound remote, while baseline compares normalize the local side to match decoded baseline wire

A change-gated 8-byte rich_sha digest persisted inline in the binding entry must track consecutive identical wire emissions and trigger a single read-back GET at the third emission to recover from divergence

Concurrent both-sides edits of description must keep local value as winner, raise an outbound-field-conflict alert recording the remote value, and route baseline refresh through the sole writer _advance_baselines
The WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefinition to decode(to_wire(t)) must not shift the DC comment-diff dedup key, keeping comment rendering unchanged while affecting only description handling

Cutover must degrade gracefully to plain-text ADF behavior when marklas extra is absent, flag must default to OFF per client opt-in, and no per-pass timestamp storage is permitted to avoid the prior 12.62 KB anti-pattern
